tag: the metabolic outcome is dropped from the status surface again
why: THE DEFECT FU-344 NAMES. The record existed on the beat since W533 and reached no surface, so an operator saw a running heartbeat with no breaches and would infer the avatar was emitting. Renaming the key is how it would quietly leave again.

tag: a withheld cycle reports that it emitted
old: "emitted": (False if _withheld else None if _status is None else True),
why: Six measured stages and an empty mouth is this platform's NORMAL state. Collapsing the outcome into the measurement is the claim this row exists to stop: the stages were real, the delivery was not.

tag: the withheld reason is dropped, leaving only the status
why: A refusal with no reason is a refusal a reader cannot act on, and the gate's own sentence is the only thing that explains why a full cycle delivered nothing.

tag: the page stops distinguishing a withheld emission
why: `emitted` is THREE-STATE and this is the exact collapse that loses the middle one: with this gate a withheld cycle (false) renders the delivered badge. A page that tests a three-state field for truthiness cannot tell 'withheld' from 'delivered'.

tag: the settlement receipt claims finality again
why: The original. What happened is a local dict entry: no chain was contacted, nothing was locked and nothing was minted. The UEG payload carried is_simulated all along — the disclosure sat where no consumer looks and was absent from the only thing a caller receives.

tag: the algorithm name returns under a field that reads as performed
why: FU-347's precise point: the field carried a standardised algorithm name with a standards citation and no simulation marker of its own, while the only disclosure lived in the class docstring. A consumer reading it sees a named post-quantum primitive and nothing to say no code implements it.

tag: a treaty nothing signed is recorded as active
why: This record GATES a capital contribution path — contribute_to_shared_pool refuses unless a peer has a treaty — so a simulated signature was the key to a real-looking flow. ACTIVE is a claim that two parties agreed; what happened is that two parties were named.

tag: the renamed placeholder leaves a second user behind
why: THE SECOND-WRITER CLASS, restored exactly as it occurred this round: the rename was applied to the returned record and the ledger payload still referenced the old name, which raises NameError at call time on a path no test reaches. Asserted on the AST rather than by calling, because the call site is unreached.
